recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Editing current source would duplicate existing guidance or risk diverging from FHIR-14237's later clarification; no core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5960.
issue_request: FHIR-5960 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search issue asking that token search apply to ContactPoint attributes, specifically on Patient and Practitioner, with comments adding Person and RelatedPerson.
initial_application: Git commit f0d0e629d2c20055b8eed059c070d96ac0e1f90d, titled 'Tracker #5960 Telecon Search parameter type token', changed Patient, Practitioner, Person, and RelatedPerson telecom search spreadsheet rows from string to token. The current generated search-parameter bundles preserve this as token parameters on telecom, phone, and email ContactPoint paths.
additional_context: Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and Person are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-14237 refined the same ContactPoint token-search area by requiring no pipe syntax for ContactPoint, uri, and boolean tokens and by allowing server-specific ContactPoint matching behavior; current source/search.html reflects that later guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html already lists ContactPoint as a token-search FHIR type, explains ContactPoint token searches use only the code/value form without a system pipe, and includes ContactPoint.value in the token datatype table. The resource search-parameter bundles already define telecom/email/phone ContactPoint searches as type token for the issue's affected resources.
